entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I... I ordered something and it's not right. I'm a bit overwhelmed by the website. I have this jersey, and I don't know what to do.
I can definitely help you with that. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
A preference? I guess? I just got the wrong size. It's really... well, it's too tight. I don't understand the sizing chart, and now I'm stuck. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can absolutely help you. It sounds like you'd like to do an exchange for a different size. Let me just confirm your order details. One moment.

Okay, I see your order here. You received the Pro-Weave jersey three days ago. I have great news for you – our apparel, like this jersey, has a 90-day return and exchange policy. You are well within that window.
Oh, really? 90 days? I thought I read something about 10 days and I was panicking. It's all so confusing.

I understand how that can happen. That stricter policy applies only to our new electronic wearables. For your item, we can definitely process this exchange for you right away. I can email you a prepaid return label right now.
You can? Oh, that would be such a relief! Thank you so much. So I can get a bigger size?

Yes. The email I'm sending will have a link to complete the exchange process online, where you can select the new size you need. As soon as the tracking on the return label shows the original jersey is on its way back to us, we'll ship out the replacement. Does that sound good?
That sounds perfect. Thank you, Alex. You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again!
Alright. Have a great day and enjoy your new gear once it arrives! Thank you for calling VeloFit.
